articles.title: Scientists uncover a hidden map of the brain with 539 distinct regions
articles.summary: Scientists have uncovered a hidden layer of organization in the brain by creating the first detailed 3D map of its lipids, the fatty molecules essential for brain structure and communication.

articles.title: How Does Life Unfold? A Landscape Metaphor Comes Into Its Own.
articles.summary: C.H. Waddington’s powerful image of embryonic stem cells specializing on a rolling landscape has captivated biologists since the 1950s. Experimental data is finally confirming, and complicating, his visionary ideas.

articles.title: Solar Orbiter tracks origin of mysterious magnetic switchbacks
articles.summary: The European Space Agency-led Solar Orbiter spacecraft has flown through an S-shaped kink known as a ‘switchback’ in the solar wind’s magnetic field.

articles.title: Newly discovered 3D 'chair' shape can fill all space without repeating patterns
articles.summary: Software developer Ioannis Tsiokos has reported the discovery of a three-dimensional shape, which roughly resembles a chair, that can fill space infinitely without repeating a pattern.
